aliases: Which support person/s may you seek assistance from in implementing an inclusive learning environment?
Who are some support persons that may assist in inclusive learning?
banglaExplanation: কিছু learner-এর specific needs পূরণে প্রশিক্ষক একা যথেষ্ট না; তখন support people লাগে।
যেমন family members, interpreters, note takers, career counsellors, peer support।
তাদের work and learning process-এ রাখতে হয়, যদি appropriate হয় আর সবাই agreed থাকে।
মনে রাখবেন: inclusive practice মানে শুধু কারও সাথে support জুড়ে দেওয়া না; difference-কে মূল্য দেওয়া।

example.bn: শ্রবণপ্রতিবন্ধী learner-এর জন্য centre interpreter আনে, আর এক সহপাঠী note দিয়ে সাহায্য করে।
example.en: A deaf learner joins a computer course. The centre brings a sign language interpreter, and a classmate shares notes.

importance.bn: CBT&A L4 Written Test — Inclusivity & Maintenance (Short 4) আর CBLM 2 Self Check 2 (Q2): 2 জায়গায় এসেছে। CBLM 2-এ highlight করা আছে। পরীক্ষায় short question হিসেবে আসে। অবশ্যই পড়বেন।

short.modelAnswer:
Support persons assist learners to overcome barriers and participate fully in training and assessment. Examples:
1. Interpreters: assist learners with limited English or hearing impairment
2. Peer support: guide learners and build confidence
3. Family members and carers: assist with mobility, communication or personal care
4. Career counsellors: provide career support
5. Note takers, case workers, library and technical support personnel, student services officers

realQuestions.label: CBLM 2 Self Check 2 (Q2)
realQuestions.question:
Which support person/s may you seek assistance from in implementing an inclusive
learning environment?

realQuestions.answer:
Support persons assist learners to overcome barriers and participate fully in training and
assessment.
Examples and Roles:
Teacher Aides / Learning Support Officers: 1. Help learners with disabilities during training or
assessments. 2. Provide one-on-one guidance or assist with equipment.
Interpreters / Translators: 1. Assist learners with limited English proficiency or hearing impairment. 2.
Translate instructions, questions, or responses.
Counsellors / Student Advisors: 1. Provide emotional, social, or career support. 2. Help learners manage
stress or personal issues affecting learning.
Mentors / Peer Support: 1. Guide learners through tasks or practical activities. 2. Encourage
participation and build confidence.
Family Members / Carers (where appropriate): 1. Assist with mobility, communication, or personal care
needs during training.
